description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design, build and train AI-driven systems that work with complex technical data, owning core services end-to-end as one of the first engineering hires. Collaborate with customers and fellow engineers to ship dependable features into production, prototyping quickly and iterating often.
 What you'll do
 - Design and implement core workflows and supporting infrastructure for AI agents, including context handling and indexing approaches.
 - Build agents and machine learning models that interpret, reason over and modify complex technical data.
 - Integrate these systems with enterprise-grade tools and platforms.
 - Partner with customers and engineers to deliver reliable, intuitive AI-powered features in production.
 - Prototype quickly, test ideas with real users and release frequently.
 - Help shape engineering culture, architecture decisions and product direction.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A university degree in a computing or machine learning field, or comparable hands-on experience.
 - Roughly 2 to 6 years of relevant experience, with openness to exceptional new graduates.
 - Strong Python skills and experience with common machine learning libraries.
 - A record of building production machine learning or AI systems.
 - Solid understanding of large language model design and current agent research.
 - Practical experience with search and information retrieval.
 - Ability to move quickly from idea to production with real care for the customer experience.
 - Curious, entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in technology.
 - Ability to work on-site in the Bay Area, with relocation welcome; remote will be considered for outstanding candidates.
 Bonus points
 - Prior time spent on applied ML, backend or AI infrastructure work.
 - Experience applying machine learning to geometric data.
 - Track record of high-impact work or published research at leading AI teams.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 250,000 per year
 - Health insurance coverage
 - Flexible time off
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
